prov.heading: Provision for Credit Losses
prov.text: The provision for credit losses on loans was $14.9 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026, an increase of $5.6 million from $9.3 million for the three months ended September 30, 2025, and was $37.2 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, an increase of $9.9 million from $27.2 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2025. The ACL as of September 30, 2026, June 30, 2026, and September 30, 2025, totaled $189.0 million, $181.9 million, and $170.2 million, or 1.28%, 1.26%, and 1.28% of loans, net of unearned income, respectively. Annualized net credit charge-offs to quarter-to-date average loans were 0.21% for the three months ended September 30, 2026, a 6 basis points decrease compared to 0.27% for the third quarter of 2025. Annualized net credit charge-offs to year-to-date average loans were 0.19% for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, compared to 0.22% for the corresponding period in 2025. Nonperforming loans decreased to $161.6 million, or 1.10% of total loans, at September 30, 2026 from $168.8 million, or 1.23% of total loans at December 31, 2025, and decreased compared to $167.6 million, or 1.26% of total loans, at September 30, 2025. See the section captioned “Asset Quality” located elsewhere in this item for additional discussion related to provision for credit losses.

net.heading: Summary of Net Income
net.text:
We reported net income and net income available to common stockholders of $87.3 million for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, compared to net income and net income available to common stockholders of $65.6 million for the third quarter of 2025. Net income was $256.1 million and net income available to common stockholders was $256.0 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, compared to net income and net income available to common stockholders of $190.2 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2025. The increase in net income for both the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026 compared to 2025 was driven by growth in both net interest income and noninterest income, even after adjusting for the $148,000 securities gains for the quarter and nine months ended September 30, 2026, and $7.8 million and $16.4 million of securities losses for the quarter and nine months ended September 30, 2025, respectively.

Basic and diluted earnings per common share were both $0.80 for the three months ended September 30, 2026, compared to $0.60 in the corresponding period in 2025. Basic and diluted earnings per common share were both $2.34 for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, compared to $1.74 for both in the corresponding period in 2025.

Net interest income.text: Net interest income is the difference between the income earned on interest-earning assets and interest paid on interest-bearing liabilities used to support such assets. The major factors that affect net interest income are changes in volumes, the yield on interest-earning assets and the cost of interest-bearing liabilities. Management’s ability to respond to changes in interest rates by effective asset-liability management techniques is critical to maintaining the stability of the net interest margin and the momentum of our primary source of earnings.

intro.text: We are a bank holding company within the meaning of the Bank Holding Company Act of 1956 and are headquartered in Birmingham, Alabama. Through our wholly-owned subsidiary bank, we operate 33 full-service banking offices located in Alabama, Florida, Georgia, North Carolina, South Carolina, Tennessee, and Virginia. We also operate a loan production office in Florida. Through our bank, we originate commercial, consumer and other loans and accept deposits, provide electronic banking services, such as online and mobile banking, including remote deposit capture, deliver treasury and cash management services and provide correspondent banking services to other financial institutions.
